InstallerSettings.Label: Deploy mode
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Managed downloads the Office source into the content (about 2.3 GB) and pins the version. Online installs from the CDN at install time and takes the channel's current build.

InstallerSettings.Label: Migrate architecture
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Changes an installed Office to the architecture of this package. Use it for 32-bit to 64-bit upgrades only: with this on, an x86 package changes an installed 64-bit Office to 32-bit.

InstallerSettings.Label: Shared computer activation
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Turns on shared computer activation for RDS and VDI hosts. Leave it off for normal PCs.

InstallerSettings.Label: Languages
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: The Office languages to install, as ODT language IDs separated by commas, for example en-us,de-de,fr-fr. The first is the main language. Each language adds to the size of the content.

InstallerSettings.Label: Let ConfigMgr manage Office updates
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: OfficeMgmtCOM: lets ConfigMgr manage and deploy Office updates through COM. Turn it off when another tool updates Office.

InstallerSettings.Label: Office updates
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves Office updates on, as Office does by default. Off writes Updates Enabled=FALSE.

InstallerSettings.Label: Close running Office apps
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: FORCEAPPSHUTDOWN: closes open Office apps so that the install can finish. Unsaved work in them is lost.

InstallerSettings.Label: Remove installed Office MSI versions
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: RemoveMSI: removes an Office version that was installed with Windows Installer before this one installs.

InstallerSettings.Label: Device-based licensing
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Licenses the device and not the user (DeviceBasedLicensing 1). Needs a plan that supports it. Leave it off for user-licensed PCs.

InstallerSettings.Label: Access
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves Microsoft Access out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Excel
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves Excel out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: OneDrive for Business (Groove)
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves the legacy OneDrive for Business sync client out; the modern OneDrive client is a separate install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Skype for Business (Lync)
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves Skype for Business out.

InstallerSettings.Label: OneDrive (modern)
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves the per-user OneDrive client Office would install out; deploy OneDrive separately.

InstallerSettings.Label: OneNote
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves OneNote out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Outlook (classic)
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves classic Outlook out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Outlook for Windows (new)
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves the new Outlook for Windows out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: PowerPoint
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves PowerPoint out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Publisher
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves Publisher out of the install.

InstallerSettings.Label: Teams
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves the bundled Teams installer out; deploy Teams separately.

InstallerSettings.Label: Word
InstallerSettings.Tooltip: Leaves Word out of the install.
